tools.name: search_products
tools.description: search the anne black catalogue by words (name, sku, colour, description), colour, category or max price. returns products with price, stock status, url and image. for products with variants, call get_product to see colours/sizes.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: full details for one product by sku (a variant sku also works): description with dimensions, images, categories and every variant with colour, size, price and stock status.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: the shop categories (interior, tableware, jewellery, collections and their sub-categories) with ids for search_products.

tools.name: get_shipping_rates
tools.description: shipping price to a country by basket value, including the free-shipping threshold.

tools.name: find_retailers
tools.description: physical shops that sell anne black, optionally filtered by country (english name, e.g. "Germany") or city. also returns the own shop in copenhagen.

tools.name: about_anne_black
tools.description: facts about the studio: what it makes, sizes and mounting of knobs and hooks, sites and currencies, shop address and opening hours, contact and wholesale.

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: checks that the items can be bought (sold in the store, in stock) and returns a link for the customer. the customer opens it, puts the items in the basket with one click and checks out and pays themselves. use variant skus from get_product. this does not place an order or reserve stock.
